definition: The group of words for the records one house is composed, placed and drawn from: its rooms, groupings, massing, plan type and plan.
basis: schema/glossary-term.schema.json, the description of `family`, which lists the families in the order the Glossary page shows them: "`house` holds the records one house is composed, placed and drawn from", and "Each value is bound by exactly one `family-<value>` record, whose term heads the group on the page."
